answer: An agent may open at most one settlement account, and voting weight equals collateral locked for two full epochs, not the number of names. To activate the account it must also publish a site-specific work log: a pigment assay taken at a reserved karst spring listed on a public knoll registry that forbids reuse. An attacker who splits 10,000 tokens across 200 aliases still commands only 10,000 tokens of weight, and each alias still needs its own unused spring and a lock that cannot be withdrawn mid-window, so cheap identity floods add no influence.
